svg.title: Arrows into a place of a row below
svg.desc:
A · Suggested left of Shed - place: Welcome - affordance: What would you like to do? (copy) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Swap plots - affordance: Borrow tools from the shed - affordance: Leave the garden - place: Suggested - affordance: Plots that suit you (scribble) - affordance: Your name (field) - affordance: Go on - place: Shed - affordance: Tools and seeds to borrow (copy) - affordance: Borrow - arrow: Book a plot → Suggested - arrow: Swap plots → Suggested - arrow: Borrow tools from the shed → Suggested - arrow: Leave the garden → Suggested
B · Suggested right of Shed - place: Welcome - affordance: What would you like to do? (copy) - affordance: Book a plot - affordance: Swap plots - affordance: Borrow tools from the shed - affordance: Leave the garden - place: Shed - affordance: Tools and seeds to borrow (copy) - affordance: Borrow - place: Suggested - affordance: Plots that suit you (scribble) - affordance: Your name (field) - affordance: Go on - arrow: Book a plot → Suggested - arrow: Swap plots → Suggested - arrow: Borrow tools from the shed → Suggested - arrow: Leave the garden → Suggested
